create_inference_endpoint: create an InferenceEndpoint object from raw API response data with namespace and token
wait_inference_endpoint: wait for an Inference Endpoint to reach running status with optional timeout and refresh interval
update_inference_endpoint: update an Inference Endpoint's compute configuration or deployed model settings
pause_inference_endpoint: pause an Inference Endpoint to stop charges and prevent billing while paused
delete_inference_endpoint: delete an Inference Endpoint permanently with no option to reverse the operation
